relationships.subject: deltamethrin
relationships.evidence_quote: The most surprising finding was an enhanced slow inactivation induced by deltamethrin in all three Nav subtypes.

relationships.subject: deltamethrin
relationships.evidence_quote: For all three Nav subtypes, we observed increased persistent and tail currents that are typical for Nav channels modified by deltamethrin.

key_findings: Deltamethrin enhances slow inactivation of human Nav1.7, Nav1.8 and Nav1.9_C4, in addition to increasing persistent and tail currents.
Use-dependent modification of Nav1.8 by deltamethrin occurred only at a -90 mV holding potential, consistent with tail-current accumulation.
